entities.summary: Olivia Catherina Merry is a New Zealand field hockey player for the national team. She competed in the women's hockey tournament at the 2014 Commonwealth Games where she won a bronze medal. She also attended the 2018 Gold Coast Commonwealth Games where she and her team won gold.
